description: This file contains mock class definitions for various HDMI CEC and related components used in unit testing. It utilizes Google Mock for creating mock implementations of interfaces such as LibCCECImpl, SystemAudioStatusImpl, PowerStatusImpl, and others. These mocks are designed to facilitate testing by simulating component behavior without requiring actual hardware or complex dependencies.

classes.name: LibCCECImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for the LibCCECImpl interface, used to test HDMI CEC communication functions.

classes.name: SystemAudioStatusImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for SystemAudioStatusImpl, simulating system audio status behaviors.

classes.name: AudioStatusImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for AudioStatusImpl, used in testing audio status-related functionalities.

classes.name: PowerStatusImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for PowerStatusImpl, used to simulate power status behaviors.

classes.name: AbortReasonImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for AbortReasonImpl, for testing abort reason handling.

classes.name: ShortAudioDescriptorImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for ShortAudioDescriptorImpl, simulating audio descriptor behaviors.

classes.name: ConnectionImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for ConnectionImpl, used to simulate connection operations and message passing.

classes.name: LogicalAddressImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for LogicalAddressImpl, representing logical address behaviors.

classes.name: MessageEncoderMock
classes.description: Mock class for MessageEncoderImpl, used to test message encoding logic.

classes.name: MessageDecoderMock
classes.description: Mock class for MessageDecoderImpl, used to test message decoding logic.
